responsibility: Declares channel-based decimal text I/O for LONGINT and LONGCARD values. It specifies reading signed and unsigned whole numbers from IOChan channels and writing them in fields of a requested width, extending the ISO whole-number I/O family to the gm2 long integer types.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for LongWholeIO: it declares the exported channel I/O procedures for LONGINT and LONGCARD values, while LongWholeIO.mod implements the decimal scanning and formatting behavior behind them.
